Subject: Sync follow-ups: roadmap asks & exec priority lane

Team — thanks for a focused sync this morning. Small set of follow-ups + alignment for QBR / exec asks below. Please reply with confirmations by EOD Wed so I can lock the pre-read.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Product ask: finalize tokenization behavior for streaming endpoints (karthik) — due Wed 6/9. Blockers: need perf numbers for 4k vs 8k context.
- Demo artifact: export trimmed demo recording + short highlights (ava) — due Tue 6/8; attaching deck for context (QBR-prep-deck-v1.pptx).
- Procurement: confirm SSO/KMS language and initial term-sheet to send to Horizon (marissa) — due Thu 6/10.
- Exec lane: Vivek to review and sign off any items that require SLA or pricing exceptions — decision by Thu 6/10.

Notes:
- Samir: you flagged PCI adjacency and longer retention for audit logs — Marissa will template the ask and include recommended controls.
- We agreed to keep the demo on the 1.5min highlights for the QBR. I trimmed the deck to the 3 most material slides.

Attachments: QBR-prep-deck-v1.pptx (pptx, 4 slides)

Quick replies ok — if anything blocks your due date, call me.

Thanks,

Ava Chen
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0187

Thanks — quick clarifying note on tokenization behavior: the perf delta between 4k and 8k at current kernels is ~18% p95 latency for streaming, but that assumes full KV cache warm. I'm going to run a microbenchmark for the mixed-request profile Samir mentioned and post numbers by EOD Tue.

On Tue I'll also drop a snippet of the streaming config we recommend for Horizon to avoid tail-latency spikes.

- Karthik

Adding procurement context — Samir, copied for visibility. Drafting the term sheet now; two asks we need clarified from your side:

1) Target contract term (12 vs 24 months) — affects committed capacity pricing.
2) Required retention timeline for audit logs (30/90/365 days) and whether logs must be stored in customer-managed S3 (yes/no).

I'll attach the procurement term sheet stub; please review and highlight any legal must-haves. I can turn this into a redline-ready PDF for your legal team once we have answers.

Attachment: procurement-term-sheet.pdf (stub)

marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@horizon-analytics.com>

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:13:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sync follow-ups: roadmap asks & exec priority lane

Thanks, everyone — quick answers from Horizon's side:

- Term: leaning 24 months; prefer a 12+12 with automatic renewal clause.
- Retention: initial requirement 90 days; we may need 365 for certain regulated pipelines but will scope that into a schedule.
- KMS: must support CUSTOMER_MANAGED keys; Samir will send a KMS contact.

Can you confirm whether longer retention (365) will impact pricing materially? Also, we'd like the demo recording after you trim it — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samir

Thanks for the updates — good progress. Two executive notes:

1) Pricing/Retention: we can accommodate a 90-day retention in standard pricing. 365-day retention will require a storage surcharge; I'm ok to offer a capped surcharge for the pilot (addendum: see HubSpot HS-3421987 for the internal note). Marissa: please draft an explicit surcharge line and a rollback clause for the pilot.

2) Exec lane & SLAs: I want tokenization behavior and any kernel-level perf changes to be flagged as "exec lane" for the QBR readout so we don't drop to a non-SLA fallback without sign-off. Karthik — please mark any config that would change p95 by >10% as exec-escalate.

Ava — once we have the final numbers and the redline-ready term-sheet, I'll approve the pre-read and we'll lock the QBR agenda.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
